title: nan
authors: Zhao J.; Deng Z.; Su W.; Lou B.; Liu Y.
key_contribution: Proposes an indoor UAV localization framework fusing UWB multi-anchor calibration with factor graph optimization and VIO constraints, validated on public datasets and real-world indoor flights.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
